gaps.title: Button inline padding apart from height
gaps.note: Gestalt's lg buttons are 48px with 14px padding (Follow, Log in, share), md 36px with 10px, sm 32px (`comp-button-*`); the census reads the same 14px on 16 secondary buttons across the signed-in app
gaps.standin: `density: touch` pads 24px at 48px (+10px on primary, secondary and quiet, both modes)

gaps.title: Menu row height
gaps.note: Dropdown rows are 35.2px: 8px padding around 16/500 labels (the signed-in profile menu, `--sema-space-200`); the signed-out More options flyout row is 28px at 14/500
gaps.standin: 40px rows at `density: touch` (`menuRows: auto`; `match` gives 48px)

gaps.title: Menu labels close to the row edge
gaps.note: Menu labels sit 8px from the row edge (`--sema-space-200`), in the signed-out flyout and the signed-in dropdowns alike
gaps.standin: 12px at `density: touch` (+4px, both modes)

gaps.title: Tooltip size
gaps.note: 34px tooltips: 12/400 white on #000 with 8px block padding (97 tooltips across the signed-in app)
gaps.standin: 28px at 12/400 (-6px, both modes)

gaps.title: Badge text at body-small size
gaps.note: The info badge (New on Trends) is 20px tall with 4px padding at 14/500
gaps.standin: 20px with 7px padding at 12/500 (+3px, -2px text)

gaps.title: Heading sizes on their own scale
gaps.note: 36px and 28px page titles (700, -0.5px), 20px section titles and 16px board titles (700); the signed-in settings and boards repeat 28/20/16
gaps.standin: `titleStyle: bold` (36/30/24/20px): h2 +2px, h3 +4px, h4 +4px

gaps.title: Per-role letter spacing
gaps.note: Headings at 28px and up tracked -0.5px; 20px and 16px headings untracked
gaps.standin: no heading tracking with `titleStyle: bold` (`tight` tracks but drops to 600)

gaps.title: Neutral links at body weight
gaps.note: The login modal's Join for free is ink at 400, underlined
gaps.standin: `linkColor: neutral` sets 500 (+100, both modes)

gaps.title: Menu rows at label weight
gaps.note: Dropdown rows at 16/500 (signed in) and the signed-out flyout row at 14/500
gaps.standin: menu rows at 16/400 (-100; +2px on the flyout's 14px row)

gaps.title: Labels inside the field
gaps.note: Signed in, the account and profile settings fields and selects carry their label inside a 72–79px box (r16, 1px #91918c, the value padded 35–41px from the top); the signed-out login modal's fields are 62.8px at r12 the same way. The business sign-up form keeps 48px fields under a label
gaps.standin: label above a 48px field (`fieldLabel: regular`)

gaps.title: Search filled and edgeless while text fields stay outlined
gaps.note: The header search, signed in and out, is a 48px #e5e5e0 field with 16px corners, no edge and a 16px search icon; form fields stay white inside 1px #91918c
gaps.standin: search fields follow `inputStyle: outline`, a white box inside the strong #91918c edge

gaps.title: Links and badges in a second accent, apart from the button brand
gaps.note: Text links take `--sema-color-text-link`, blue #2b48d4 at 14/500 with no underline at rest, underlined on hover (#2741bf) and press (#223aaa), a 2px #435ee5 ring 2px out on focus (95 links across the signed-in app), while CTAs stay red #e60023. Badges and labels take the same blue: "New" is #2b48d4 on #ebeeff
gaps.standin: ink links underlined (`linkColor: neutral`, `linkUnderline: always`), as on the signed-out login modal; `accent` would paint them red; accent badges and tags take the brand, so plan, role and label badges read red (soft #e60023) across the blocks

gaps.title: Tab and side-nav labels black at rest
gaps.note: Profile tabs (Created, Saved) are 16/500 #000 at rest and selected, only the underline moves (text@tab.1, 26 tabs); settings sidebar links are 16/700 #000 current or not, the current one marked by a black underline under its label instead of a fill (text@link.3, 164 links)
gaps.standin: tab and sidebar labels rest in muted ink (oklch 0.50 light, 0.78 dark); the current sidebar row sits on a fill (`navMarker: fill`), weight matched by `navItemWeight: bold`

gaps.title: Chips filled from a multi-hue pastel set
gaps.note: Search guide chips come in a base #e5e5e0 and a pastel set (`comp-searchguide-color-background-*`: blue #dbe1ff / #92a4ff, green #c7f0da / #83ddad, orange, purple, red, weak and strong, and a rainbow gradient), each turning #33332e when selected
gaps.standin: every chip on the soft neutral fill

gaps.title: Slider range and knob in different colors
gaps.note: A gray #74746c range on a #e5e5e0 track under a #435ee5 knob with a 2px white border
gaps.standin: `sliderColor: neutral`: range and knob in ink

gaps.title: Card radius between rungs
gaps.note: Trends cards at 20px between the 16px and 24px rungs of the 16px base; pins and board covers stay 16px
gaps.standin: `roleCard: lg` (16px, -4px in both modes)

gaps.title: Dialog corners
gaps.note: Modals at 20px (`comp-modal-rounding-container-desktop`), between the 16px and 24px rungs
gaps.standin: `rolePanel: xl` (24px, +4px in both modes)

gaps.title: Control corners that step with the control size
gaps.note: Buttons, icon buttons, toggle buttons, dropdowns and tags round 16px at lg, 12px at md and 8px at sm (`comp-button-rounding-*` and siblings)
gaps.standin: one control radius (16px) at every size

gaps.title: Tooltip corners below the item rung
gaps.note: 8px tooltips (`comp-tooltip-rounding-container`) beside 8px menu rows
gaps.standin: the inline-item rung, 12px with `roleItem: sm` (+4px, both modes)

gaps.title: Badge corners below the detail rung
gaps.note: 4px badges (`comp-badge-rounding-container`)
gaps.standin: `badgeShape: rounded` reads the detail rung, 8px (+4px)

gaps.title: Checkbox corners as a share of the box
gaps.note: 8px corners on the 24px md checkbox, 4px on the 16px sm one (`comp-checkbox-rounding-container-*`)
gaps.standin: `checkCorner: sharp` (2px): the detail rung would draw the 16px box as a circle

gaps.title: Selected chips inset inside their box
gaps.note: A selected search chip draws its #33332e fill 2px inside the 48px chip, so it reads 44px tall
gaps.standin: selected toggles keep the full 48px box (+4px, both modes)

gaps.title: Focus ring over a page-colored inner line
gaps.note: Buttons focus with a 2px #435ee5 outline flush on their edge over a 2px inner line in the page color (white, #000 in dark); fields drop their edge for the same flush 2px outline; links take the ring 2px out
gaps.standin: `focusRingGap: 2` draws the same bands 2px further out; fields recolor and thicken their edge to 2px (`focusInputStyle: thick-edge`), which draws the same line

gaps.title: A lighter focus ring in dark
gaps.note: The focus ring lightens to #677eee in dark (`--sema-color-border-focus`)
gaps.standin: the light #435ee5 ring in both modes (ΔE 0.094 in dark)

gaps.title: Outline fields clear in dark
gaps.note: Dark fields and selects are #000 on the #000 page inside 1px #91918c (calico dark tokens)
gaps.standin: `inputStyle: outline` fills dark fields rgb(39, 39, 36) (ΔE 0.272)

gaps.title: Dark cards on the page tone
gaps.note: Trends cards #000 on the #000 page in dark
gaps.standin: `surfaceLayers: same` still lifts dark cards to oklab L 0.166

gaps.title: Color engine: dark overlays lifted well above a black page, with no edge
gaps.note: Dark menus and dialogs on #33332e above the #000 page, no edge, the 0 3px 12px .2 shadow
gaps.standin: menus and dialogs at oklab L 0.182 (ΔE 0.137) inside a 1px L 0.279 line

gaps.title: Color engine: pure black and white ink over a tinted neutral ramp
gaps.note: Text, headings, labels, field values, menu rows, quiet buttons and links in #000 over warm neutrals at OKLCH h≈107 (`--sema-color-text-default`)
gaps.standin: `fg` at oklch 0.239 (ΔE 0.239 on 15 light parts)

gaps.title: Color engine: pure white ink in dark
gaps.note: #ffffff text and labels in the calico dark theme
gaps.standin: `fg` at oklch 0.956 (ΔE 0.044 on 15 dark parts)

gaps.title: Color engine: muted text a step darker in dark
gaps.note: Muted text #91918c in dark (#62625b in light matches)
gaps.standin: `fg-muted` at oklch 0.776 in dark (ΔE 0.120)

gaps.title: Color engine: soft fills two steps into the neutrals
gaps.note: Secondary buttons, icon buttons and search chips on #e5e5e0 (dark #494943)
gaps.standin: `buttonSecondary: soft` at oklch 0.965 / 0.215 (ΔE 0.044 / 0.189)

gaps.title: Color engine: inverse chips a step off the ink
gaps.note: Selected search chips and segments #33332e under white (dark #c8c8c1 under black); toasts #494943
gaps.standin: `toggleSelected: inverse` fills with the ink, oklch 0.239 / 0.956 (ΔE 0.080 / 0.125)

gaps.title: Color engine: field line step
gaps.note: Fields, selects and checkboxes edged in #91918c in both modes
gaps.standin: `controlEdge: strong` at oklch 0.60 (ΔE 0.056)
